Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To both parties: the SGD 30.18 charge on trip TRP-02830 is reduced and SGD 6.80 is refunded to the rider. The ride was a RYDE_X trip from Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 to Blk 420 Woodlands St 41. The GPS trace measures 22.95 km against the booked optimal route of 16.7 km; POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern, so the excess is 6.25 km, or 37.4% of the optimal route, and both establishment tests are met (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%). A route deviation is therefore established. It is not a MATERIAL deviation: 6.25 km is below the 8.0 km bar and 37.4% is below the 50% bar, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not triggered, no full-refund uplift is available and no driver-conduct referral arises. In any event the two counters POL-RD-06 names show no pattern (deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 395 completed trips in 90 days; 0.0025 against the 0.05 trigger), so the check would change nothing had it run. The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare: (SGD 3.80 base + 0.75 x 16.7 km = 12.525 + 0.28 x 22.5 min = 6.30) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + SGD 0.80 platform fee = SGD 23.425 recomputed fare. Refund = charged_total SGD 30.18 - SGD 23.425 = SGD 6.755, rounded UP to SGD 6.80. That is 22.5% of the charge, far below the 90% that would make it a full refund, and well above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The driver's explanations cannot alter this. There is no chat log for the trip (0 messages), so there was no rider instruction to detour or re-route (POL-RD-04); pickup and dropoff were never amended, so there is no amended optimal route to re-test (POL-RD-05); and the trip was not a pooled RYDE_POOL trip, so no co-rider distance is excluded (POL-RD-12). On the expressway jam in the driver's statement: the bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip - the only advisory identifier, EV-ADVIS-02830-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, POL-RD-13(1) applies and the case is decided on the measured excess rather than escalated under POL-RD-10(5). Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there are no ERP or toll lines, no airport surcharge applies (the trip did not originate at an airport), and no charge line is unmatched, so there is no separate pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes as well as schema purposes - 181 fixes at a 10-second interval, zero gaps, 100% coverage - so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and no escalation is required. Confidence is 0.93, above the 0.70 floor; every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02830, EV-TRIP-02830 and EV-FARE-02830) is at full weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 6.80 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue, subject to the appeal route.
